kits.name: wedding
kits.label: Wedding
kits.recipe: Elegant wedding reception. On every table: one floor-length white tablecloth, one floral centerpiece at the table center, and two candles 0.55 m either side of the center along the table. Swap every chair to the gold chiavari chair. Add one dance floor (about 4 x 2.5 m) in the best open area near the front of the stage; if loose chairs (not at a table) are in the way, remove them. Center one flower arch on the stage. Hang string lights across the hall, about 7 strands evenly spaced along the room width, running front to back. Keep all aisles >= 44 in and exits clear.

kits.name: theater
kits.label: Theater
kits.recipe: Theater / keynote setup. Remove all tables (keep fixed building items). Place chairs in straight rows facing the stage, centered on the stage, with a 44-in center aisle aligned with the stage center and 44-in side aisles along the walls; first row ~1 m from the stage front; row pitch ~0.92 m; seat pitch ~0.52 m; skip seats that would collide with columns or block exits. Stop at the requested guest count. Add a black curtain behind the stage (stage width + 3 m), two spotlights on stands at the front corners of the stage aimed at it, and a red aisle runner down the center aisle.

kits.name: conference
kits.label: Conference
kits.recipe: Classroom conference: tables in rows facing the stage with 2-3 chairs per table on the stage-facing side, a center aisle, podium on stage, screens on.

kits.name: cabaret
kits.label: Cabaret / gala
kits.recipe: Cabaret or gala night on the open floor. Remove loose chairs (type chair) from the open floor in front of the stage; never touch fixed seating on risers. Place round tables (round_table, 1.76 m with linen) in a staggered grid on the open floor: table edges at least 1.5 m from the stage front, about 2.7 m center to center, 44-in aisles from every door to the stage steps, and nothing on stage steps or aisle steps. Put 8 chairs around each table (6 if space is tight), evenly spaced at 0.95 m from the table center, each facing the table center. One candle at each table center. Optional: string lights over the floor. Stop at the requested guest count.

kits.name: living_room_set
kits.label: Living room set (stage)
kits.recipe: Dress the stage as a living room, for a play, a talk-show or a fireside chat. Everything stands on the stage, which the app places on top automatically. Back wall: two scenic flats near the back of the stage, angled about 15 degrees inward like the corners of a room; leave a gap between them so the lit cyclorama shows through like a window. Center stage, facing the audience: the sofa, with the coffee table about 0.9 m in front of it and a rug under both. Two armchairs either side of the coffee table, turned about 40 degrees toward the sofa. A floor lamp beside the sofa, a bookshelf against one flat and a plant against the other. Keep 1 m clear along the stage front edge and in front of the stage steps; stay inside the masking drapes. If the user names a color, use the sofa and armchair presets (teal, mustard, grey, burgundy).
